pokedexEntries.us: It doesn’t just transform itself—it also has the power to make hundreds of people see its illusions.

pokedexEntries.um: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon cares deeply about others of its kind, and it will conjure terrifying illusions to keep its den and pack safe.

pokedexEntries.sh: Seeking to ease the burden of their solitude, lonely Trainers tell Zoroark to show illusions to them.
